W. A. Raviendra Wickramasinghe, Returning Officer, Gampaha Pradeshiya Sabha. District Election Office, Gampaha, 30th of January, 2026. texts.gazette-2473-29: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිකා සමාාජාවාාදී ජානරජායේ� ගැැසට් පත්‍රය අති වියේ�ෂ The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka EXTRAORDINARY අංකා 2473/29 - 2026 ජානවාාරි මාස 30 වාැනි සිකුරාදාා - 2026.01.30 No. 2473/29 - FRIDAY, JANUARY 30, 2026 (Published by Authority) PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE THALAWA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262) WHEREAS the office of member of Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation; And whereas the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Herath Mudiyanselage Pinhamige Ranjith, the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(l)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Ward Number 12 - Ikiriwewa of Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days; And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Anawaththuge Bandu to fill such vacancy; Therefore I, Nuwara Pakshage Pivithuru Indika Raviraj Gunarathna, Returning Officer of the Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(l)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Anawaththuge Bandu was elected as the member of the Ward Number 12 - Ikiriwewa of Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha. N. P. P. I. R. Gunarathna, Returning Officer, Thalawa Pradeshiya Sabha. District Election Office, Anuradhapura, 30th of January, 2026.
